predictions: As with most recent seasons, the amount of stuff that goes into the week 1 newsletter prevents me from having enough space to include both the season-long and the weekly picks. But I still do them both, and then report the week 1 results to you guys here, so that we have a full season of picks. And I had a pretty great first week. 20-5 to kick things off, and among my three losses were a 12-12, a 13-11, and a 14-10. Only got one really really wrong, but I'll eventually figure out F this season… == Two 1-0 teams ==

Match of the week: (G Div.) The Neighborhood Dart Knights @ That's What She Said. Here we are in just week 2, and it's already a matchup of my top two preseason picks in G. And they did both take care of their business in week 1, but one of these is looking a bit more in control to kick things off. I think What She Said was winner, winner… 14-10.

Match #2: (E Div.) Death Throw @ Dart Side of the Moon. Oh, a nice spicy pairing of leaders here already, matching up the top two in E so far. Both teams rode DCkt sweeps last week, and won comfortably (and this despite Dart Side falling behind 0-6 in 301). I'm guessing a 6-point deficit isn't in Dart Side's future again tonight, so I'll take them, 14-10.

Match #3: (B Div.) Dart Attack @ Double In, Stumble Out. If you read my preseason predictions, you know that I expected Consistent to win B. But you also know that I thought this pairing would be the fight for 2nd (and a potential climb to A), so the fact that these are two of the week 1 winners is no surprise to me. I think I'll go with Stumble Out in a 1001.

Match #4: (E Div.) Liquor Possee @ Irish Ton. The other two week 1 winners in E (along with match #2 above) tangle here. Unlike the two above, these two needed an '01 comeback to squeak one out, and now this winner is going to make that pay off in a top two slot. Possee, 13-11.

Match #5: (G Div.) Dart Vader's @ Bottoms Up. G division, like E, has an excellent second week pairing up all the week 1 winners. This one features one of the newcomers against one of the recent up-and-comers. And I'm always a fan of up-and-comers… Bottoms Up stay on top, 15-9. == Two 0-1 Teams ==

Match #6: (B Div.) Raging Bulls Eyes @ Trips Are For Kids. Yeah, I have no idea what happened to Raging last week. I don't accept that as representative of how their season will go. For Kids though, did exactly what I expected (close against a top squad). Kids, 14-10.
Match #7: (E Div.) Cheap Shots @ Runs with Corks. Both these teams kinda had to think they were about to win last week. Alas, here they are, both 0-1. Tough start for somebody… Cheap, 13-11.

Match #8: (G Div.) We're Sexy & We Throw It @ Killer Dee's. Yeah, it's early, but one of these teams could be looking up out of a pretty deep hole after just two weeks. Think I'll go with Dee's, 13-11.
Match #9: (E Div.) Bangin the Wire @ Duck Around & Find Out. In week 1, these two combined for a 2-22 record in cricket. Oof. I don't feel like I have a good clue what happens here. Ducks? 13-11.

Match #10: (G Div.) Darts and Crafts @ 21 Dart Salute. Hey look, it's an unknown entity against an unknown entity. Obviously, I'm going to nail this pick just perfectly. The Salute it shall be, 14-10. == A 1-0 Team Against A Team Yet To Play A Match ==

Match #11: (C Div.) The Outlaws @ Shooter McGavin. Two of my top half C picks here in The Outlaws' spring debut, with McGavin having already beaten another top competitor. The Outlaws, 13-11. == An 0-1 Team Against A Team Yet To Play A Match ==

Match #12: (A Div.) Darty Minds @ The Bullies. Darty announced their return in A in a very solid way last week. Now they get an even bigger early test in the form of the defending champs. Bullies, 17-7.
Match #13: (D Div.) Red-eye Rangers @ Sharky's Machine. The Rangers nearly took what I expect to be a title contender last week. And immediately they draw another. I think I'll go Machine, 14-10.
